text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Wah, the prepared food smells so good~.
Are those croquettes? Freshly fried!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if I should buy something to take home... Huh?
Is that Trainer over there?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
(...Are you worrying over something?
Like what to make for dinner?)

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I wonder if I can be of any help...
I should call out—... Ah.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
(...At the shop next door.
I-I've never seen them looking so deep in thought...)

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: ...Could it be?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: (W-What should I do? She left without buying anything, so I just ended up following her without thinking...)

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
(...Could it be
that she doesn't have an appetite?
Is that why she can't decide what to eat?)

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
"...I wish she'd just relax once in a while.
Even if I say that, though, I'm sure...
she'll just tell me, 'I'm fine.'"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Spending busy days filled with
races and training, Dants Flame...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To reward her hard work, I looked around for ideas
to make something delicious by hand, but everything I saw—
choice_data_list: Looks like something we could get at the academy cafeteria...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps because I've been thinking about it all morning,
my thoughts have become completely scattered...
I let out an involuntary groan to myself.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: T-Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Y-Yes. Um...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
(...Always worrying, thinking, and supporting me...
Trainer...)

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
(Even if I ask right now,
she might not tell me what's bothering her.
Still...)

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: (For once, I want to be helpful too!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...I wonder what is wrong.
You have quite a serious look on your face.
Could there be an urgent matter you wish to consult me about?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Um... um, you see...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"She seems hesitant to say it out loud...
She must have something on her mind after all.
I should take the initiative here—"
choice_data_list: If anything's troubling you, I'll listen to whatever it is!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: If something is troubling you, please, turn to me—!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
...S-So that was it.
You were trying to... treat me to a meal...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry for jumping to conclusions.
And for meddling where I shouldn't have...
choice_data_list: No, I'm sorry for causing that misunderstanding

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
N-No! It's not something you should
apologize for, Trainer... If anything,
I'm sorry for making you worry on my account...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Because... training is for my own sake in the first place.
If anything, I should be the one thanking you—

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
(......Ah. T-That's it!
If I do it this way—)

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Um, if it's okay with you...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
...Ngh,
How about... we make lunch boxes for each other and have a picnic!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...I ended up deciding to make a bento for Dantsu Flame.
I bought various ingredients, but what kind of
contents should I go with...?"
choice_data_list: As expected, nothing is more satisfying than meat!
...What should I do? I can't decide...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I decided to make grilled fish as the main dish,
along with seasoned mixed rice. I hope they enjoy it...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Mmm~! Ufufu... Gulp.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
The grilled mackerel is so good~!
The salmon mixed rice is rich in flavor too,
it's simply the best!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Japanese food is so comforting, isn't it?
...Ah, how does the dish I made taste?
choice_data_list: This rice ball is seasoned to perfection!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... When it comes to boxed lunches, rice balls are a classic.
I'm so glad you enjoyed them.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text: Even though it's a familiar taste... eating it in a special place like this makes it feel a little extra special. Besides...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Maybe it's because... you're here with me, Trainer.
...Ehehe.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While munching on the rice balls made by Dantsu Flame,
we spent a peaceful and relaxing day.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I made a hearty bento with hamburg steak as the main dish.
I hope she likes it...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Mmm.
*munch munch*... *gulp*

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
The hamburg steak is so delicious~!
Even though it's cold, the juices just burst in my mouth!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
This bento is surprisingly invigorating.
It's so satisfying too...
I'm feeling really motivated now!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Trainer... h-how is it?
I tried my best to consider
nutrition and everything when making this boxed lunch...
choice_data_list: This ginger pork really makes me want more rice!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, I'm so glad~ I grated and minced the ginger
myself so it would be even more nutritious.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
I'm so glad I worked hard... in my own way.
Fufu, please take your time and savor it!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Even though you took the trouble to suggest a picnic, now I can't decide on the right lunchbox for it...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
“How is... the lunch I made?
D-did I pack in too many different side dishes...?”
choice_data_list: There's so many, it's so exciting!

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
W-Whew, I'm glad...! What's in season,
what Trainer likes... I was worried I had overthought things a bit.

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Your bento looks so lively too, Trainer!
Stuffed bell peppers, and is this shumai?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Gratin, shrimp tempura, roast beef,
fresh spring rolls, handmade soba...
choice_data_list: I couldn't narrow down what to pick...

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
N-No! It's super worldwide and...
um... like a buffet!
Yes, it's just like a buffet, it's amazing!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the end, I couldn't make a meal for Dants Flame that I was truly satisfied with...
I vowed to get it right next time.
